languages_frameworks: Vercel AI SDK (ToolLoopAgent) with Google Gemini

implemented_capabilities.capability: Temporally ordered circular money-flow (round-trip) detection over Account-Transaction-Account chains, 2 and 3 hops
implemented_capabilities.notes: Fixed-length Cypher patterns (a)-[:SENT]->(tx1)-[:RECEIVED_BY]->(b)-...->(a) with tx2.timestamp > tx1.timestamp ordering and min-amount filters; 1-3 hop forward flow queries capped at LIMIT 20. Bounded to 3-hop cycles; no variable-length or cycle algorithm.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Fraud pattern detectors (shared devices, high-risk/shell merchants, structuring near 5k/10k thresholds, velocity vs avg_monthly_volume, geo mismatch, unverified-KYC accounts)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Six fixed Cypher aggregations with hard-coded thresholds (e.g. 4500-5000, total > avg_monthly_volume*3). Heuristic rules, not statistical or graph-algorithm detection; SHARES_DEVICE edges are pre-materialised in the seed rather than derived at query time.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Account investigation dossier (account, outbound/inbound txs, devices, cases, alerts, shared-device peers, cycles)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Seven parallel parameterised queries merged into one JSON response with circularFlowDetected flag.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Action tools: flag account (risk/status update + Alert node) and escalate case (FraudCase node + FLAGGED_IN edges)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real graph writes with no approval step. Account lookup uses toLower(name) CONTAINS toLower($name) with no LIMIT before SET, so a short or ambiguous name updates every matching account; the model can freeze accounts directly.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Free-form Cypher tool for the LLM
implemented_capabilities.notes: Passes model-written Cypher to graph.query (write-capable, not ro_query) with no allow-list, read-only enforcement or row/time limit beyond slicing the first 50 rows.
716 lines of Math.random-generated accounts, merchants, devices and transactions with dates relative to now; results are not reproducible and not real data.

implemented_capabilities.capability: LLM investigation chat agent and graph visualisation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Gemini tool loop (stopWhen 8 steps) whose behaviour is governed by a long system prompt; the report writing and 'reasoning' are model text, while the graph tools underneath are the real part.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Account {risk_score, kyc_verified, status, country, avg_monthly_volume...}, Transaction {amount, timestamp, type, channel, is_international...}, Merchant {risk_level, is_shell_company}, Device {is_vpn, is_emulator}, FraudCase, Alert. Edges: SENT, RECEIVED_BY, AT, USES, USED_IN, FLAGGED_IN, INVOLVES, HAS_ALERT, TRIGGERED_BY, SHARES_DEVICE. Transactions are reified as nodes between accounts, enabling per-hop timestamp/amount predicates. Cypher notes in code highlight FalkorDB quirks (round() one arg, no EXISTS{}, booleans as 1/0). Mostly parameterised; no APOC/GDS and no FalkorDB algo.* calls (no PageRank/WCC/cycle algorithms used).
algorithms: Fixed-depth 2/3-hop circular flow match with strictly increasing timestamps (mcp-server.ts:investigate_account, trace_money_flow)
Forward k-hop flow tracing with min-amount filter, k in 1..4 (mcp-server.ts:trace_money_flow; the 4-hop request falls into the 3-hop branch)
backend_interfaces: Next.js route handlers: POST /api/chat (streaming agent), GET /api/graph?focus=..., POST /api/seed

MCP stdio server (mcp-server.ts) tools: query_graph, investigate_account, trace_money_flow, detect_patterns, flag_account, escalate_case, get_graph_schema; resources fraudgraph://schema and fraudgraph://guide
frontend_interfaces: Next.js page with ChatPanel (markdown report streaming) and GraphCanvas (highlighted investigation subgraph), lucide icons, Tailwind
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Single ToolLoopAgent (Gemini) with 7 tools and an 8-step cap; no persistent agent memory beyond the writes it makes (Alert, FraudCase nodes). No handoffs or state machine.
security_findings: mcp-server.ts:73-85 and src/app/api/chat/route.ts:41-85 - query_graph executes arbitrary LLM/client-supplied Cypher with graph.query (read-write, unauthenticated); allows MATCH...DETACH DELETE and data exfiltration

mcp-server.ts:~300-340 (flag_account) and src/app/api/chat/route.ts:416-470 - MATCH ... WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) followed by SET without LIMIT/uniqueness, mass-updating all matching accounts; no approval gate on freezing accounts
src/app/api/seed/route.ts:1-12 - unauthenticated POST /api/seed reseeds (and presumably clears) the shared graph

mcp-server.ts:~340 and src/app/api/chat/route.ts:447 - SET clause assembled by template string from fixed fragments (a.risk_score = $risk, a.status = $status); values parameterised, not injectable as written
src/app/api/chat/route.ts:605-615 - raw error strings returned to the client
mcp-config.json:5 - committed absolute developer path in cwd (information leak only); .env.example holds placeholders; no hard-coded secrets, eval or exec found
duplicates_or_overlaps: Financial fraud ring / circular flow detection overlaps ShaktiEighteen Financial_Crime_Agent, manav-Mnv hound-aml, mirah227 walletrace and other fraud-graph repos in the hackathon set; agent-with-raw-Cypher pattern is common.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - writes Alert and FraudCase nodes with timestamps but has no provenance linkage, supersession, temporal validity beyond transaction ordering, dependency invalidation or approval gating.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Concise temporally ordered 2/3-hop round-trip Cypher over reified transaction nodes plus six threshold-based fraud heuristics that port easily into a Financial Fraud pack; reusable as query templates, not as an engine.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB; Gemini key only for the chat agent. Cypher templates are language-agnostic

strategy_rationale: Small set of useful Cypher templates, but the surrounding system is TypeScript, untested, runs on random seed data, and exposes unrestricted write Cypher and un-gated account freezing; borrow the circular-flow and structuring queries into the Python fraud pack instead of integrating code.
